original_test_intent: Suspend and resume encryption for one owned payload instance, verify the required confidentiality/integrity/session behavior, and restore the approved protected state.
original_method: Use the vendor/IPMI-supported transition on an isolated active payload after baseline, security approval and independent recovery are established.
manual_activity: Security owner approves the isolated payload, exact suspend/resume meaning and temporary exposure envelope; operator confirms recovery immediately before the transition.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Correctly rejects guessed execution; paired OOB history makes the case conditionally executable after an approved package and confirmation.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Vendor-approved protected suspend/resume runner bound to one owned payload/session; never guess raw bytes.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Capture protected baseline, confirm one isolated payload, execute exactly one supported suspend/resume sequence, verify encryption/integrity and session continuity without secret disclosure, then prove protected final state and cleanup.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Defines a bounded conditional workflow without altering the TBD Master.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Read-only policy inspection is only pre/post evidence and cannot replace the functional transition.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: An uncertain state can expose management traffic or strand keys/sessions.

project_override_considerations: Alternative tooling must preserve the exact state machine, isolated scope, crypto evidence and recovery; it cannot merely report current encryption.
expected_evidence: Protected final state, cleanup and audit

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Master supplies no suspend/resume semantics or criteria and asks to clear security logs; the title alone cannot define key/session behavior or an acceptable temporary state.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The functional goal and OOB implementation family are known; exact state machine, isolated target and security approval are execution inputs, so review need not remain permanently blocked.

review_improvement: Retains the cryptographic state-change coverage and adds non-disclosure, recovery and explicit confirmation instead of downgrading to a read-only check.
independent_technical_reasoning: This is a high-impact but bounded stateful security test. It cannot be FULLY AUTOMATABLE or safely inferred from TBD, yet an approved vendor package and isolated fixture make it executable; REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION fits the risk and coverage.
